## What would you like Dragon Scrolls to do?

Describe the idea in plain English.

## Why would this help?

Explain how this would make the app more useful, easier, or more fun.

## Example

Describe what the feature might look like.

Example: “I want a Party Manager tab where I can see all saved characters together.”

## Is this urgent or just nice to have?

Choose one:

- Must-have
- Nice-to-have
- Maybe someday

## Anything else?

Add sketches, screenshots, links, or extra notes here.
